technical-summary: Serving manifest v1 amendment 13: 80 more engine options get a manifest field (sampling 20, limits 13, chat 6, lora 5, vision 12, tuning 22, diagnostics 2 sections under spec.processes.engine), each bound to its flag by the registry; the resolver reads them as section.name keys from the generated registry, the writer nests them, rad0009 needs no change, and a contract test fails when a new engine option is neither bound nor a kind of run.
user-summary-candidate: The serving manifest can now carry every engine setting that was only available as a command-line flag (sampling defaults, HTTP limits, chat/reasoning, vision, tuning, diagnostics).
